brief: A box to hold the joint where I extend a 230 V mains cable to a new wall socket in my garage.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full with cover top+bottom and 6 end caps forms a closed single-cell box; check_build ok, meshClash clear
requirements.requirement: Closed box to hold the cable joint

requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 and port:0#0,0#3 are hex-port-gland cable plates; 4 remaining side ports closed with hex-port-plug plugs
requirements.requirement: Ways in/out for the existing and new cable runs, with unused holes closed

requirements.evidence: Parts are 3D-printed plastic chosen by user; configurator checks fit/collisions only and knows nothing about flammability, dielectric strength, IP rating, heat resistance or wiring-regulations approval
requirements.requirement: Safe containment of a 230 V mains joint for a garage wall-socket extension

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell box with top/bottom covers, end caps and two cable-plate entries, 4 other ports plugged. Shape only: 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts are not rated for mains voltage, heat, flammability or electrical protection and cannot legally house a 230V joint. Use a certified mains junction / adaptable box installed by a qualified electrician to extend the socket circuit; this build must not be connected to mains.

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.

parts.name: Cable comb
parts.use: A block of teeth a cable pushes in between sideways, so a bundle is kept in order without anything to thread or undo.
